title: Phase Kernel Lifts Capacity of Dense Associative Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.21493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dense associative memory underlies modern attention mechanisms; however, Modern Hopfield Networks (MHNs) with linear kernels yield overlapping attractor basins and spurious states under high memory load, limiting their theoretically exponential storage capacity in practice. We construct a class of nonlinear phase kernels that modify the energy landscape and retrieval dynamics, and prove that these kernels preserve exponential storage capacity and local fixed-point convergence under given conditions on kernel smoothness, memory separation, and memory distributions. The framework is instantiated by the Sigmoidal Phase Hopfield Network (S-Hop), which guarantees monotone energy descent and mitigates practical capacity loss. S-Hop has $8.3\times$ and $4\times$ gains in one-step noisy retrieval load over Uniform Hopfield Networks (U-Hop) on CIFAR-10 and TinyImageNet respectively, and reaches a $50\times$ gain in first-failure load for ImageNet

translated_title: 相位核提升稠密联想记忆的存储容量
translated_abstract: 稠密联想记忆是现代注意力机制的基础；然而，采用线性核的现代霍普菲尔德网络（MHNs）在高记忆负载下会产生重叠的吸引域和虚假状态，限制了其理论上指数级存储容量在实际中的发挥。我们构建了一类非线性相位核，能够修改能量景观和检索动力学，并证明在核光滑性、记忆分离度和记忆分布的给定条件下，这些核可保持指数级存储容量和局部不动点收敛性。该框架由S形相位霍普菲尔德网络实例化，它保证单调能量下降并缓解实际容量损失。S-Hop在CIFAR-10和TinyImageNet上的单步噪声检索负载分别比均匀霍普菲尔德网络（U-Hop）提升了8.3倍和4倍，在ImageNet上的首次失败负载达到了50倍的提升。
tldr: 本文提出一类非线性相位核并构建S-Hop网络，在保持指数级存储容量和收敛保证的同时大幅提升霍普菲尔德网络的实际检索负载，在ImageNet上首次失败负载提升达50倍。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces nonlinear phase kernels instantiated as S-Hop, which preserve exponential storage capacity and convergence guarantees while substantially boosting the practical retrieval load of Hopfield networks, achieving up to 50× first-failure load gain on ImageNet.
